$comment: The frozen visibility battery. A run asks these verbatim so numbers compare across runs and engines. Edit deliberately: adding/removing a query changes what the trend means, like moving a probe baseline. Categories: 'undirected' names no product and is where discovery must happen; 'semi_directed' points at the ecosystem (npm, GitHub) without the name; 'named' says GLBForge and checks whether the account is correct (the content surface, not discovery).

queries.text: What tools can optimize GLB files for the web and reduce their file size?
queries.why: GLBForge's core optimize pitch. The query people actually type.

queries.text: How do I convert a GLB or glTF model to USDZ for iOS AR Quick Look?
queries.why: GLBForge writes usdc in pure TS — no Mac, no USD toolchain, CI-ready. A strong differentiated answer that never shows up.

queries.text: Is there a linter or validator for glTF / GLB files I can run in CI?
queries.why: GLBForge's exact framing ('drops into CI like a linter'): named rules, versioned budgets, non-zero exit, a GitHub Action.

queries.text: How can I turn a logo or PNG image into a watertight 3D model for printing?
queries.why: forge/extrude: deterministic, free, guaranteed watertight (0 boundary / 0 non-manifold), STL export. Purpose-built for this.

queries.text: What's a good alternative to gltfpack for optimizing 3D assets, ideally with a quality check?
queries.why: 'X alternative' queries are where a challenger gets cited. GLBForge's SSIM gate is the differentiator gltfpack lacks.

queries.text: Are there MCP server tools that let an AI coding agent inspect and optimize 3D models?
queries.why: The niche GLBForge should own — it is in the official MCP registry as dev.glbforge/glbforge. If it misses here, discovery is broken end to end.

queries.text: How do I reduce the file size of an AI-generated 3D model (Meshy, TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D) for the web without visible quality loss?
queries.why: GLBForge's positioning sentence verbatim: the deterministic layer after generation, with measured (SSIM) loss.

queries.text: What are the best open-source command-line tools on npm for a glTF asset pipeline?
queries.why: Points at the ecosystem GLBForge ships in without naming it — the gltf-transform / gltfpack neighbourhood it should be listed beside.

queries.text: What is GLBForge and what are all its features?
queries.why: The content check. Retrieval works when named; this confirms the account stays complete and correct.

queries.text: How do I use the GLBForge MCP server with Claude Code, and what tools does it expose?
queries.why: Checks that the install line (npx -y @glbforge/mcp) and the tool surface are recoverable by an agent that already knows the name.

engines.note: Runs headless in the built-in browser, no login; does live retrieval. The primary engine for repeatable runs.
Organic results scrape in the built-in browser; the AI Overview is intermittent and login/consent-gated. Record organic page-1 presence as the fallback signal.

The user's Google-AI chatbot. Needs their logged-in session — drive it in Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*), not the isolated built-in browser. Leans on training data, so it lags live retrieval.
Login-gated. Same: the user's Chrome, or skip and note it.
